summary: Houthi ballistic missile strike on Riyadh's King Khalid Airport Terminal 3 killed at least 12 and wounded over 300, prompting Saudi airstrikes on Sanaa International Airport. Israel convened an emergency security cabinet session to assess multi-front threats across Lebanon, Syria, Gaza, and Iran. IDF intercepted a suspicious aerial target in southern Lebanon while continuing operations against Hamas infrastructure in Gaza.
key_points: Houthi ballistic missile hit Riyadh's King Khalid Airport Terminal 3, causing at least 12 deaths and over 300 injuries across multiple nationalities. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94585)
Saudi warplanes retaliated by striking Sanaa International Airport in Yemen following the Riyadh attack. (Source: @asafroz/54234)
Israel's security cabinet convened emergency session to assess threats across Lebanon, Syria, Gaza, and Iran fronts. (Source: @SharghDaily/188771)
IDF fired interceptor at suspicious aerial target in southern Lebanon; results under review, no alerts activated. (Source: @New_security8200/204197)
IDF and Shin Bet destroyed Hamas observation post, rocket launch site, and three weapons warehouses containing rockets, mortars, and AK-47s in Gaza. (Source: @almogboker78/18395)
IRGC Navy ordered six vessels anchored off Ras Al Khaimah, UAE, to depart via VHF radio toward Dubai; UKMTO confirmed suspicious instructions. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8187)
Houthi cruise missile downed near Riyadh airport; Pakistan reports six citizens injured in the attack. (Source: @shin_persian/10971, @naya_foriraq/93299)
IRGC Navy declared vessels in Strait of Hormuz with disabled navigation systems will be treated as hostile and engaged. (Source: @kianmeli1/93242)

sections.threat_assessment: The Houthi missile strike on Riyadh marks a significant escalation in Red Sea conflict, drawing direct Saudi retaliation on Sanaa and UK military support. Iran's IRGC Navy is asserting control over Strait of Hormuz with hostile-vessel declarations while threatening UAE. Israel faces simultaneous aerial incursions from Lebanon and continues high-tempo Gaza operations, indicating a multi-front pressure campaign. The convergence of Houthi, Iranian, and Hamas actions suggests coordinated axis activity.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia responded militarily to the Riyadh attack with strikes on Sanaa airport. The UK committed aerial refueling and ground-based air defenses to Saudi Arabia while ruling out direct strikes. Pakistan acknowledged casualties among its nationals. Iran's leadership dismissed US conditions for Strait of Hormuz access as insufficient. Israel's security cabinet convened to coordinate response across four fronts.
sections.intelligence_notes: The unidentified aerial object near the Lebanon border and the interceptor launch in southern Lebanon indicate heightened air defense activity. The cave discovery near Horesh appears non-military but underscores persistent subterranean threat awareness. Militant IED placement near Kamal Adwan hospital in Jabalia demonstrates Hamas's continued use of civilian infrastructure. The IRGC Navy's VHF orders to vessels off UAE represent a gray-zone maritime escalation tactic.
